  WHY: When `gh pr create` fails with a Go HTTP header timeout and the recovery lookup finds no PR, the loop falls through to `outcome=give_up`, even though the failure is the same transient class as the incident this PR targets (release run 39926633796's "GraphQL: Something went wrong").
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: extend the regex with the transient markers in `audit_consumer_drift.py` (`timeout awaiting`, `eof occurred`, `connection aborted`, `context deadline exceeded`, `client.timeout exceeded`, `network is unreachable`, `could not resolve host`, `temporary failure in name resolution`, `no route to host`) (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
